name: @pila/api
description: HTTP API that runs @pila/factcheck for the Pila Chrome extension

scripts.build:lambda: esbuild src/lambda.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --conditions=source --external:@aws-sdk/* --legal-comments=none --banner:js="import{createRequire}from'node:module';const require=createRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist-lambda/index.mjs && cd dist-lambda && rm -f function.zip && zip -q function.zip index.mjs
